question: Please list all the superpowers of 3-D Man.
evidence: 3-D Man refers to superhero_name = '3-D Man'; superpowers refers to power_name
gold_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T3.power_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = '3-D Man'

question: For each attribute, what is the average value among the superheroes from Marvel Comics taller than 200 cm?

question: Among the superheroes taller than 200 cm, what is the percentage of those who are published by Marvel Comics and have the super power of "Super Strength" or "Invulnerability"?

  AND (T1.id IN (SELECT hp.hero_id FROM hero_power AS hp JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id WHERE sp.power_name = 'Super Strength') OR T1.id IN (SELECT hp.hero_id FROM hero_power AS hp JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id WHERE sp.power_name = 'Invulnerability'))

question: For the 5 superheroes with the highest total attribute score, say whether each has the super power of Super Strength ('Yes' or 'No').
evidence: total attribute score refers to SUM(attribute_value) per hero; ties are broken by the lowest id; super power of Super Strength refers to power_name = 'Super Strength'
gold_sql:
SELECT T1.superhero_name,
       CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hero_power AS hp INNER JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
                         WHERE hp.hero_id = T1.id AND sp.power_name = 'Super Strength') THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN (SELECT hero_id, SUM(attribute_value) AS total FROM hero_attribute GROUP BY hero_id) AS T2
  ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
ORDER BY T2.total DESC, T1.id LIMIT 5

question: List the superheroes at least 250 cm tall and, for those weighing at least 200 kg, say whether they are zombies (1 for a zombie, 0 otherwise; NULL for the others).

gold_sql:

       CASE WHEN T1.weight_kg >= 200 THEN CASE WHEN T2.race = 'Zombie' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END
FROM superhero AS T1 LEFT JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.height_cm >= 250
